# Modules

`ghost_modules`

The older utility modules: the wave spawner behaviour, plus the Heal Area and
Safe Start Disabler modules — the originals, with their own Eden entries.

The spawners are placed through Ghost - Force; the heal and safe-start
modules are placed directly, as they always were.
